courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 疏浚泥沙有益利用
related.transfer: 可遷移「疏浚稜體與斷面」與「測深不確定度預算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；疏浚泥沙有益利用的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dredging prism and sections" and "Sounding uncertainty budget" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚；疏浚泥沙有益利用則以用材料分流地形高程和生態追蹤判斷疏浚土的有益利用為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting; Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment centres on evaluate dredged-sediment reuse through material routing, elevation and ecological follow-up, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「疏浚稜體與斷面」與「材料分流與去向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到疏浚泥沙有益利用，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dredging prism and sections” and “Material routing and destinations”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cover thickness and erosion reserve", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「疏浚稜體與斷面」與「測深不確定度預算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型港口沉箱碼頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚；大型港口沉箱碼頭則以將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting; Large-port caisson quay walls centres on trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「疏浚稜體與斷面」與「主動土壓假設」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型港口沉箱碼頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「護舷曲線積分」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dredging prism and sections” and “Active earth-pressure assumptions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Large-port caisson quay walls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Integrating fender response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 港池航道疏浚
history.text: 港灣疏浚同時包含航行幾何、材料移動與環境介面，不能只用挖泥船大小描述技術演進。二〇一五年工兵團手冊整理新挖、維護和疏浚物管理；二〇二二年薩凡納港官方紀錄明確指加深疏浚部分完成，而非所有配套同日完工。國際水道組織二〇二四年第六點二版標準提供品質與用途框架，不等於設備操作說明。本課另以巴爾的摩航道材料進入波普勒島復育的歷程說明來源與去向必須連結。所有設備、方量和淨空數字都是合成練習，不是上述專案的實際作業資料。
history.textEn: Harbor dredging combines navigation geometry, material movement and environmental interfaces rather than simply the size of dredging machinery. The2015 USACE manual addresses new work, maintenance and material management. The2022 Savannah release specifically records completion of deepening dredging, not all associated works on the same date. IHO’s2024 edition6.2.0 provides survey-quality and intended-use context rather than equipment instructions. Baltimore-channel material used at Poplar Island separately illustrates the link between source and destination. Equipment, volume and clearance values throughout the course are synthetic exercises, not operating records from these projects.
